## Featured project

### [SpeakBetter AI](https://github.com/Kesavamoorthig06/speak-better-ai)

An AI-powered public speaking coach that helps users improve delivery, clarity, and confidence through voice and video analysis.

- Eye contact detection
- Filler word tracking
- Speech pace and clarity metrics
- Presentation improvement reports
